intent: Cover Bryceville inside the Nassau Village-Ratliff page: both are unincorporated Nassau County, so the same county rules reach a turf project in either place.
distinctValue: Names Bryceville by name and states plainly which authority applies (Nassau County, not a town or HOA) and that this page's rules — the Sec. 37.05 landscaping line, the county/SJRWMD watering order and Fla. Stat. 125.572 — reach it the same way, rather than leaving it as a bare mention.

sources.label: Wikipedia: Bryceville, Florida
supports: Bryceville is an unincorporated community in Nassau County, Florida, United States.
Bryceville lies on US 301, in the southwestern part of the county.

sources.label: Nassau County Land Development Code, Appendix A, Art. 37, Sec. 37.05 (landscaping)
supports: Synthetic or artificial trees, shrubs, groundcovers or vines are not acceptable substitutes

sources.label: St. Johns River Water Management District: watering restrictions
supports: Restrictions apply to private wells and pumps, ground or surface water and water from public and private utilities

sources.label: Fla. Stat. 125.572: regulation of synthetic turf
supports: protects compliant turf on single-family property of one acre or less, and since the state standard took effect on 19 May 2026 a county can't ban it there
